🔄 I'd swap Triceps Pushdown for Lateral Raise. It puts almost no load on the elbow and still works your shoulders for your push day. Tap Swap on the card to make the change. I skipped dips and overhead extensions because they stress the elbow even more.

💡 Your presses will still hit your triceps, so don't worry about skipping direct triceps work today. Keep the loads lighter and stop any movement that hurts.

⚠️ If the elbow pain is sharp or lasts for days, stop pressing and get it checked by a professional.
